/corecraft/forestia/blossam-brook.html.description: Blossam Brook brings the outdoors into the play structure. Palm tree towers rise over slides and a net bridge, and a curved activity trail winds along one side for children to follow on foot. Along that trail they balance, hop and crawl, then climb the towers and slide down. Blossam Brook is meant for ages 3 to 12. The product area is 34'9" x 25'3" and the safe play area is 39'9" x 31'3", so it needs a generous lawn in a park, school or township. Blossam Brook is offered in Play Red, Play Orange or Knight Blue, and capacity is listed as 15 children. Its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope have a 3-year warranty. Ask us how the trail can line up with your existing paths.
/corecraft/forestia/blossam-brook.html.spec_paragraph: The activity trail sits low to the ground, so children often step onto it from the edges. Treat the whole 39'9" x 31'3" area as play space and cover it with an impact-absorbing surface. Towers are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts and a play rope net bridge. We install self-standing or grouted to suit the soil.

/corecraft/forestia/gloracia.html.description: Gloracia is a tree-house style play station in Play Yellow. It has palm towers, a slide, a swing and a climbing net, plus an activity arm reaching out from the main tower. Children climb the net, hang from the arm and come down the slide, so the play is active without being spread too wide. The product area is 23'8" x 20'1", with a safe play area of 29'8" x 26'1", which fits a mid-sized society garden or school ground. Children from 3 to 12 can use it. Apart from Play Yellow, it is offered in Play Orange and Lemon Yellow, and capacity is listed as 15 children. Gloracia comes with a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Send us photos of your site for a layout.
/corecraft/forestia/gloracia.html.spec_paragraph: Gloracia has a swing as well as a slide, so the safe zone of 29'8" x 26'1" must include clear space in the swing path. Frames are galvanised pipe, with roto-moulded palm towers and slide and a play rope climbing net. It can be self-standing or grouted. Check the swing fittings and net knots during routine visits.

/corecraft/forestia/jungle-jive-l1.html.description: Jungle Jive-l1 is the entry piece of our Forestia jungle series, built for children aged 3 to 9. A large flower-shaped canopy shades the tower, with a slide on one side and a swing beam on the other. That mix gives small children two very different things to do in a compact space: climbing up and sliding down, or taking turns on the swing. The product area is 14'8" x 13'5" and the safe play area is 20'8" x 17'5". It comes in Mango Yellow, and capacity is listed as 15 children. Jungle Jive-l1 is covered by a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. If you are planning a toddler zone, tell us your site size and we will suggest pieces to go around it.
/corecraft/forestia/jungle-jive-l1.html.spec_paragraph: The flower canopy is roto-moulded, which keeps the deck shaded and adds no rusting surfaces. The tower and swing beam are galvanised pipe, installed self-standing or grouted. Leave clear space in front of and behind the swing seat within the 20'8" x 17'5" safe zone, and check the swing hangers regularly.

/corecraft/forestia/jungle-jive-l2.html.description: Jungle Jive-l2 is a larger version of the flower-canopy design, made for children aged 5 to 12. Under the canopy there is a slide, a tunnel and a climbing net, with activity arms reaching out from the main tower. Children balance, hop and crawl along the lower parts and climb the net to reach the slide, so it builds more physical challenge than the l1. The product area is 30' x 23'4" and the safe play area is 36' x 28'4", which suits a school or a society with older children. Colour is listed as Multi Color, and capacity is listed as 15 children. The 3-year warranty on Jungle Jive-l2 covers galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. We can suggest where to place it so the tunnel entry stays visible to parents.
/corecraft/forestia/jungle-jive-l2.html.spec_paragraph: Crawling tunnels need good drainage, because water that pools inside stops children using them. Plan a slightly raised base with rubber flooring across the 36' x 28'4" zone. The frame is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded tunnel and slide and a play rope net, installed self-standing or grouted.

/corecraft/forestia/king-kong-play-park..description: King Kong Play Park is the biggest structure in our Forestia series. A central tower in Forest Green and Sand Beige carries tube slides and bridges outward in several directions, with climbing walls and nets around it. The aerial view shows it on a circular safety surface, which is how we suggest laying it out. Children aged 3 to 12 can climb, slide, balance, hop and crawl across it, so a whole class or a crowd at a park can use it together. The product area is 50'1" x 42'5" and the safe play area is 56'1" x 48'5". Capacity is listed as 15 children. King Kong Play Park has a 3-year warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Talk to us about it for a municipal park, resort or large township.
/corecraft/forestia/king-kong-play-park..spec_paragraph: A play park of this size is grouted on a prepared base, with the safe zone of 56'1" x 48'5" covered in rubber flooring. It uses galvanised pipe, roto-moulded tube slides, composite laminate walls and play rope nets. Plan maintenance access around the edge and check bridges, nets and slide joints on a set schedule.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/1-seati.description: The 1 Seating Cum 2 Standing Twister puts three waist-twist stations on one frame: one for a seated user and two for people standing. Twisters turn the hips and waist from side to side while the user holds a handle, a gentle movement that suits older residents as well as regular walkers. Having seated and standing stations together means a senior citizen can sit while a friend or family member twists alongside. It is finished in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range of outdoor gym equipment for parks, societies and walking tracks. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our standard warranty terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Ask us for a layout of your open gym.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/1-seati.spec_paragraph: Twisters rely on a rotating platform or seat, so the bearings are the main wear part and should be checked and greased at each service. We fix the twister frame self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground. Leave enough clear space around all three stations that people waiting do not stand inside the turning area.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions, age group or warranty line in the fact sheet.
SKU FFE018D uses the 'D' suffix that elsewhere means Double, for a three-station combination. Check SKU.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/2-seati.description: This combination reverses the mix of our other twister set: two seated waist-twist stations and one standing station on a single frame. It is the better choice where most users are older adults who prefer to sit, such as a senior citizens' corner in a park or a society garden near the lift lobby. Users hold the handle and turn the hips side to side, a low-impact movement that loosens the lower back. The 2 Seating Cum 1 Standing Twister comes in Play Orange and is part of our Fun Fitness outdoor gym range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. Our standard terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. We can place it on your open gym layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/2-seati.spec_paragraph: Seated twisters need a firm, level base so the seats turn freely and do not rock. We install the frame self-standing or grouted. Keep the turning seats clear of benches and plant beds, check the bearings for play every few months, and replace any worn seat fixings promptly.

SKU FFE019D uses the 'D' (Double) suffix for a three-station combination. Check.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/6-stati.description: The 6 Station Multi Gym is a hexagonal frame with six exercise stations around it, finished in orange and grey. Six people can work out at once, each facing outward, which makes it a compact way to give a society or park a full open gym on one footprint. It suits adults of different fitness levels using the space at the same time, for example morning walkers and evening groups. The product listing gives the colour as Play Orange but does not name the six stations or give dimensions. Our sales team will share the station list, size and warranty with your quote. Under our standard warranty terms, galvanised pipes are covered for 3 years and bearings and spare parts for 1 year. Send us your site size and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/6-stati.spec_paragraph: A single hexagonal frame carrying six stations is normally grouted so that loads from several users are spread into a fixed base. Leave walking space around the outside so one user does not step into another's movement. Check every moving joint and bearing on a regular service schedule.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions, warranty or list of the six stations in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/8-stati.description: The 8 Station Multi Gym is our larger multi-station frame, finished in Ocean Grey, with eight exercise stations on one structure. It suits large parks, township clubhouses, college campuses and corporate grounds where many people exercise at the same time, especially in the early morning. Grouping the stations on one frame keeps the gym area tidy and easier to supervise and maintain than eight separate machines. Ask us for the list of eight stations and a drawing of the full layout. We will also confirm the warranty in writing; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Share your site photos and we will show where the 8 Station Multi Gym fits.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/8-stati.spec_paragraph: Because eight people may be on the frame at once, this unit is grouted into a prepared base. Ocean Grey hides dust well on busy park sites. Plan clear circulation space around the frame, and check bearings, seat fixings and handles at each maintenance visit.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions, warranty or list of stations in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/Shoulde.description: The Shoulder Twirl Double has two shoulder wheels on one post, so two people can exercise side by side. The user stands facing the wheel, holds the handle and turns it in large circles, which works the shoulder joint through its full range of movement. It is a popular machine with older adults and anyone recovering stiffness in the shoulders, and it needs no adjustment between users. The Shoulder Twirl Double is finished in Ocean Grey and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our standard warranty is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your park or society gym layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/Shoulde.spec_paragraph: The wheels turn on bearings, which are the parts to check during maintenance. The post can be installed self-standing or grouted. Place the machine so both users have room to stand square to their wheel, and keep the area behind them clear of walkers.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/abb-tra.description: The ABB Trainer is an outdoor bench for abdominal exercises, with a curved orange backrest. Users lie or sit against the curve and lift the upper body or legs, so it works the core without any moving parts. That makes it a low-maintenance addition to an open gym in a society, school or college. It suits teenagers and adults; older users may prefer the twisters for gentler core work. It is finished in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Under our standard terms, galvanised pipes have a 3-year warranty. Ask us to add the ABB Trainer to your layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/abb-tra.spec_paragraph: With no bearings or pivots, the ABB Trainer needs very little maintenance beyond checking the fixings and keeping the backrest clean. It can be self-standing or grouted. Place it on a level surface and leave space at the head and foot ends for users getting on and off.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.description: The Chest Press Cum Shoulder Press combines two pressing machines on one frame, each with its own orange seat. On the chest press, the user pushes the handles forward from chest height. On the shoulder press, the handles are pushed upward from shoulder height. Both use the user's own body weight as resistance, so there are no weights to load. Putting the two on one frame saves space in a society or corporate gym and lets two people train the upper body together. The finish is Play Orange, matching the rest of our Fun Fitness range. Request the drawing and warranty terms from us when you ask for a price. Our standard warranty covers galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.spec_paragraph: Each station has pivot points that carry the user's weight, so the bearings and seat bolts should be checked on a regular schedule. This combination frame goes in self-standing or grouted. Leave space in front of the chest press handles and above the shoulder press arms so nobody walks into the moving parts.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.description: The Chest Press Double has two seats facing pressing handles, so two people can do the same upper-body exercise side by side. Seated users push the handles forward and let them return, working the chest, shoulders and arms against their own body weight. A double unit is useful where the gym gets busy at fixed times, such as before office hours in a corporate campus or after school in a society. It comes in Play Orange, with orange seats, as part of our Fun Fitness range. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. Our standard warranty gives 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include the Chest Press Double on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.spec_paragraph: The pressing arms swing on pivots, so check bearings and seat fixings during routine maintenance. We install the double press self-standing or grouted. Leave clear space in front of both handle sets, and place it where users can see each other, which helps when two people are training together.
